# FAQ + Support | Getting Started | Troubleshooting & Support | | :--- | :--- | | **How do I use this??**
I'll be posting tutorials on my YouTube channel soon!
| **I'm getting errors when running this workflow!**
Double check that you have all of the correct models loaded. This is using the newest version of 2x upscaler (v1.1). You can change it to the older one under the Model Loader. | | **Where do I download these models??**
There is a good list of models and download links here:

Also the latest v1.1 spatial upscaler can be found here:

The tiny vae (`taeltx2_3.safetensors`) is found here:
| **How can I support you?**
If you'd like, you can buy me a coffee here!


Or follow me on my socials :)
